description: OAuth2 authentication — GitHub by default, extensible to Google and GitLab

GitHub OAuth2 client ID — create an OAuth App at github.com/settings/developers
Base URL used to build provider callback URLs. In production use your public domain (e.g. https://api.myapp.com)
Route prefix used to register OAuth login and callback routes

steps.message:
OAuth is ready. Set OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and OAUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET to enable GitHub login.
Callback URL to register: http://localhost:7331/auth/github/callback

Next: protect a route with the JWT provider:

  protected := app.Group("/api", jwtProvider.Middleware())

If DevPanel is installed, add to main.go after panel setup:

  panel.RegisterAddon(oauthManager)

To add Google or GitLab: see the comments in cmd/setup_oauth.go.
Reference: ss-keel-examples/examples/12-oauth
